findings.issue: יוֹבֵל is a common noun (H3104), left untranslated as yovel; common nouns stay Spanish.
לּוֹ is 3ms (him/it). «a ella» is feminine singular, so it does not match that suffix and reads as tierra or muralla.
לָהֶם is 3mp; «a ellas» only feminizes the suffix toward aldeas/casas.

notes: Plural casas with singular se contará matches plural בָּתֵּי plus 3ms יֵחָשֵׁב.
